there was no statistically significant difference in breast cancer beliefs between women who completed a mammography and those who did not, that the beliefs most salient to the sample as a whole were that breast cancer is a serious disease and that it is treatable if detected early, that the sample was relatively homogeneous in breast cancer beliefs, and that the beliefs of women in this study were not significantly different from those of women in previous research.

there were no statistically significant differences between the beliefs of women who participated and those who did not participate in a television-promoting, reduced-cost mammogram project.
